# DemosJarco DNS API

- **OpenAPI Version:** `3.2.0`
- **API Version:** `main`
- **Contact:** GitHub Issues <https://github.com/demosjarco/dns-checker/issues>
- **License:** [MIT](https://opensource.org/licenses/MIT)

Check DNS records for any domain or subdomain

## Contents

**Operations**

- [GET /api/regions](#scalar-operation-get-apiregions)
- [GET /api/region/{code}](#scalar-operation-get-apiregioncode)
- [GET /api/region/{code}/instance/{iata}](#scalar-operation-get-apiregioncodeinstanceiata)
- [GET /api/region/{code}/instance/{iata}/dns/{rrtype}/{hostname}](#scalar-operation-get-apiregioncodeinstanceiatadnsrrtypehostname)

## Operations

<a id="scalar-operation-get-apiregions"></a>

### GET /api/regions

- **Method:** `GET`
- **Path:** `/api/regions`

#### Responses

##### 200 Returns all Durable Object region with spawned instances

**Content type:** `application/json`

**Array of:**

`string`, possible values: `"wnam", "enam", "sam", "weur", "eeur", "apac", "apac-ne", "apac-se", "oc", "afr", "me"`

<a id="scalar-example-1"></a>

**Generated example:**

```json
[
  "wnam"
]
```

<a id="scalar-operation-get-apiregioncode"></a>

### GET /api/region/{code}

- **Method:** `GET`
- **Path:** `/api/region/{code}`

#### Path parameters

- **`code` (required)**: `string`, possible values: `"wnam", "enam", "sam", "weur", "eeur", "apac", "apac-ne", "apac-se", "oc", "afr", "me"`

#### Responses

##### 200 Lists IATA codes of deployed LocationTester instances for the requested region code.

**Content type:** `application/json`

**Array of:**

`string`, pattern: `^[A-Z]{3}$`

<a id="scalar-example-2"></a>

**Generated example:**

```json
[
  ""
]
```

<a id="scalar-operation-get-apiregioncodeinstanceiata"></a>

### GET /api/region/{code}/instance/{iata}

- **Method:** `GET`
- **Path:** `/api/region/{code}/instance/{iata}`

#### Path parameters

- **`code` (required)**: `string`, possible values: `"wnam", "enam", "sam", "weur", "eeur", "apac", "apac-ne", "apac-se", "oc", "afr", "me"`
- **`iata` (required)**: `string`, pattern: `^[A-Z]{3}$`

#### Responses

##### 200

**Content type:** `application/json`

- **`country` (required)**: `string`, minLength: `2`, maxLength: `2`
- **`latitude` (required)**: `string`, pattern: `^-?\d+(\.\d+)?$`
- **`longitude` (required)**: `string`, pattern: `^-?\d+(\.\d+)?$`
- **`municipality` (required)**: `string`, minLength: `1`

<a id="scalar-example-3"></a>

**Generated example:**

```json
{
  "latitude": "",
  "longitude": "",
  "country": "",
  "municipality": ""
}
```

##### 404 Not Found

**Content type:** `text/plain`

`string`, possible values: `"Not Found"`

<a id="scalar-example-4"></a>

**Generated example:**

```json
"Not Found"
```

<a id="scalar-operation-get-apiregioncodeinstanceiatadnsrrtypehostname"></a>

### GET /api/region/{code}/instance/{iata}/dns/{rrtype}/{hostname}

- **Method:** `GET`
- **Path:** `/api/region/{code}/instance/{iata}/dns/{rrtype}/{hostname}`

#### Path parameters

- **`code` (required)**: `string`, possible values: `"wnam", "enam", "sam", "weur", "eeur", "apac", "apac-ne", "apac-se", "oc", "afr", "me"`
- **`iata` (required)**: `string`, pattern: `^[A-Z]{3}$`
- **`rrtype` (required)**: `string`, possible values: `"A", "AAAA", "CAA", "CNAME", "MX", "NAPTR", "NS", "PTR", "SOA", "SRV", "TLSA", "TXT"`
- **`hostname` (required)**: `string`, minLength: `1`, pattern: `^(?=.{1,253}$)([a-zA-Z0-9](?:[a-zA-Z0-9-]{0,61}[a-zA-Z0-9])?\.)+[a-zA-Z]{2,63}$`

#### Responses

##### 200 Per-resolver DNS answers for queries from this location

**Content type:** `application/json`

`object`

**Additional properties:**

**Any of:**

- `null`

  Resolver unreachable or returned an error
- `array`

  Resolver response payload for query

  **Array of:**

  **Any of:**
  - `string`
  - `object`

    **Additional properties:**

    `any`
  - `array of string`
  - `array`

    **Array of:**

    `object`

    **Additional properties:**

    `any`
- `null`

<a id="scalar-example-5"></a>

**Generated example:**

```json
{
  "additionalProperty": [
    ""
  ]
}
```

##### 404 Not Found

**Content type:** `text/plain`

`string`, possible values: `"Not Found"`

<a id="scalar-example-6"></a>

**Generated example:**

```json
"Not Found"
```
